_comment: project -> Kaggle kernel. The notebook title is the folder name, and Kaggle re-slugs a kernel to its title, so pushing renames devenderj/<old-slug> to devenderj/<folder>. kernel_id must be the CURRENT ref (check `kaggle kernels list --user devenderj`); a stale ref creates a duplicate kernel.

01-credit-risk-scoring.note: tabular, CPU only; a local run is enough

02-vision-from-scratch.note: CNN + ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10; the previous kernel was deleted, so the next push creates this ref

03-ppe-safety-vision.note: YOLO26 training, 3 seeds; still on the old slug, the next push re-slugs it

04-intent-routing.note: DistilBERT fine-tune, COMPLETE; still on the old slug, the next push re-slugs it

10-rl-inventory-control.note: DQN/PPO, CPU is fine; still on the old slug, the next push re-slugs it
